Actualment, comptem amb 50 places per a: We currently offer 50 places for children and teenagers (and their families) aged 6 to 16 from Zona Nord in Nou Barris. We work in five age groups, each with a reference educator plus a supporting coordinator. Some spaces are designed for small-group work, others for all groups to mix, fostering the Ubuntu spirit and intergenerational work. We also count on invaluable volunteers supporting each group.
Actualment, la diversitat present a les: Diversity in today's classrooms is a challenge for teachers. Pupils' specific needs — learning disorders, speech and language disorders, academic difficulties and emotional distress — paint a complex picture in schools. To help address these needs, the Trampolí project has supported more than 300 families over more than a decade, establishing itself alongside the main resources and services of Ciutat Meridiana, Vallbona and Torre Baró.
